findings.detail: Eight flagged rows are supplemental currency/cost/FMV rows from table 15 with no rate columns, while matching SOI debt rows disclose reference spread and interest rate.
The Daintree Bidco Pty Limited main-SOI row is private credit but the source row itself leaves reference rate, spread, and interest rate blank.

rationale: X02 is a Class 2 row-validation item. The nine-row flag is real in material part: table 15 supplies private-credit-looking issuer/investment/currency/cost/FMV rows with no rate fields, but the matching SOI debt rows for Albion, Jupiter, Ruby, and Urban show rate/spread and interest-rate values. The parser therefore stored supplemental rows as private credit holdings without carrying the rate-bearing SOI fields. One flagged Daintree row is different: the source SOI row itself has blank reference-rate/spread and interest-rate cells, so that subcase is source-blank rather than independently extractable.
